ov: The tallest and heaviest living bird, flightless and native to parts of Africa. It lays the largest eggs of any living bird and is the fastest runner on two legs.

why.dg: If cornered, an ostrich can attack with a powerful kick.
why.et: Ostriches are farmed around the world for their meat, feathers and leather.

rg: Parts of Africa, and historically Arabia.
df: It swallows sand and pebbles, which help grind food in its gizzard, and can go days without drinking.

cf.tip: The Australian emu is smaller, the third-tallest living bird after the two ostrich species.

fx: It can run for a long time at 55 km/h, with short bursts of about 70 km/h.
